description: Source code for WebSocket link handling, including frame encoding/decoding, request/response key generation, and WebSocket protocol management within the WPEFramework Web namespace.

classes.name: Protocol
classes.description: Handles WebSocket protocol operations such as key generation, frame encoding, and decoding.

methods.name: RequestKey
methods.description: Generates a WebSocket request key based on random bytes.

methods.name: ResponseKey
methods.description: Computes the WebSocket response key from a request key.

methods.name: Encoder
methods.description: Encodes data into WebSocket frames, handling masking and frame headers.

methods.name: Decoder
methods.description: Decodes WebSocket frames, handling unmasking and frame parsing.
